name: First call with Prema Vision
detail: Five things to have in mind before a 30-minute call. Two sentences each is enough.

steps.title: Name the process
steps.detail: The one that only works because someone remembers it.

steps.title: Who carries it today
steps.detail: One person, a few, or nobody for sure.

steps.title: What it costs when it breaks
steps.detail: Hours, money, a client. A rough number is fine.

steps.title: Why now
steps.detail: What changed this month or this quarter.

steps.title: The tools it touches
steps.detail: CRM, inbox, spreadsheets, your app.

name: Is your AI ready for real users?
detail: Six checks before customers meet your agent. Each one fails quietly if you skip it.

steps.title: Keys out of the code
steps.detail: Secrets in a vault, not in prompts or the repo.

steps.title: Production apart from staging
steps.detail: Separate projects, so a test never mixes with real traces.

steps.title: Trace every step
steps.detail: Tools and retrievers too, not only the model call.

steps.title: A golden set of 30 real cases
steps.detail: Run it before every prompt or model change.

steps.title: Cost per run, with a limit
steps.detail: Know it per conversation, not from the monthly bill.

steps.title: A runbook for the night it breaks
steps.detail: Who is alerted, what they check first, how to roll back.

name: Before you hire an agency
detail: Five questions to ask before you sign. Write the answers down.

steps.title: Who owns the code and accounts?
steps.detail: Yours from the first commit, in your name.

steps.title: A fixed price per milestone?
steps.detail: And what counts as done for each one.

steps.title: How do you test?
steps.detail: Ask to see a test run, not a slide.

steps.title: What happens when you leave?
steps.detail: A handover doc a new engineer can start from.

steps.title: A client I can call
steps.detail: Not a logo. A person with a phone number.

name: Ten-minute website check
detail: Do it on your phone, the way your customers see your site.

steps.title: Open it without the www
steps.detail: A red warning page means a certificate problem.

steps.title: Open it on your phone
steps.detail: No pinching, no scrolling sideways.

steps.title: Tap your phone number
steps.detail: It should start a call, to the right number.

steps.title: Search your business name
steps.detail: The headline and the map listing should agree.

steps.title: Send yourself the contact form
steps.detail: Then check the message actually arrived.
